scope: s 2 (administrator), s 3(1), s 7, s 8(2), (3A), (3B), (4A), (5), (6), s 8A(a)-(g), ss 9, 10, 12, 13(1), (2), 14, 15(1); Cremation Regulations 1954 r 11, 12, 14(2), (4), Sch 1 Form 9 (24 hours), Sch 2 item 3. Not encoded: licensing and revocation (ss 4-6, 16), appointment of referees, s 3(2) and regs Part V, s 8B (stillborn children), the crematorium's register and notices, s 17.
